summary: IZAKA-YA is an active provider-operated crypto wallet and lending service that advertises ordinary lending yields up to 12% and has repeatedly promoted much higher short-duration campaign rates.
what_happened: Izakaya Limited states that the broader IZAKA-YA service began in December 2023. Current first-party pages describe provider-operated crypto lending integrated with a cloud wallet and Fireblocks infrastructure. During 2026 the operator published repeated promotional lending campaigns advertising annualized rates of 100%, 500%, 1000% equivalent and, in August, 100% plus a transfer bonus described as an effective 150% annualized rate. These are operator-advertised campaign terms, not evidence of realized or sustainable returns.
uncertainty_notes: The reviewed material does not independently establish the economic source or sustainability of the advertised yields, universal asset segregation or insolvency priority, or a service-independent customer recovery path. The operator's current lending articles explicitly state that crypto lending principal is not guaranteed. Exact original lending-product launch date remains unresolved.
notes: Canonical inclusion and active status are not safety endorsements. Campaign APR/APY figures are preserved as historical issuer terms and must not be presented as verified realized returns.
